source_title: Is SIR bringing anti-BJP forces together? Panel debates - India Today - India Today
source_excerpt:
In the national capital, the INDIA bloc to mobilise demonstrations at Ramlila Maidan over the Special Intensive Revision process and alleged voter list deletions, demanding the removal of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar. The panel features Congress and BJP spokespersons debating constitutional impeachment protocols, internal party differences in Karnataka, and protests over Uttar Pradesh employment regulations under Article 19. The programme reports on Maharashtra MLC election results, where the Maha Vikas Aghadi secured three graduate seats and the Mahayuti alliance retained two teachers' seats. Additionally, it highlights the Supreme Court hearing on pharmaceutical trade markups, the National Pharmaceutical Pricing Authority capping trade margins at 30 percent on 543 anti-cancer drug brands, and Karnataka mandating purchase cost disclosures on medical bills. Other developments include DVAC raids concerning an alleged cash-for-jobs scam in Tamil Nadu, a Gujarat court ruling, and Kedarnath snowfall.
